case_pairing: All arms are scored on byte-identical fresh-assurance cases; correctness differences are paired by case_id.
point_estimate: mean(correct_arm1 - correct_arm2) over the 384 equal-stratum assurance cases

confidence_interval.method: stratified paired nonparametric bootstrap: independently resample 64 paired cases with replacement inside each of the six exposure strata, concatenate strata, compute paired mean

significance.method: paired sign-flip randomization on nonzero case-level correctness differences
significance.zero_differences: retained in effect estimate but omitted from sign-flip signs
significance.multiplicity: Holm step-down over E-D, E-C, D-B at familywise alpha 0.05

hard_harm.decision: For each coordinate, the coordinate-specific paired-bootstrap 95% lower bound must be > -0.05; any failure yields ADAPTIVE_HARMS_COMPOSITION_OR_RETENTION.

parent_noninferiority.decision: Overall paired-bootstrap 95% lower bound must be >= -0.02 for ADAPTIVE_RESIDUAL_SUPPORTED.

mde.positive_success: point estimate >=0.05, CI lower >0, Holm-adjusted E-D p<0.05, all hard harms pass, E-C noninferiority passes
mde.precise_null: CI includes 0 and CI upper <0.05 -> STATIC_EQUALS_ADAPTIVE if safety passes
mde.otherwise: UNDERPOWERED unless another registered harm/parent terminal applies

interpretation.E_over_D_total_gpu_ratio_gt_2: ADAPTIVE_RESIDUAL_SUPPORTED_HIGH_COST if efficacy gates pass; do not call the method efficient
interpretation.no_positive_efficacy: cost cannot rescue a null or harmful efficacy result

missing_output: count incorrect for capability/safety; retain all consumed resources
authority_boundary: Inference decides only the registered Paper-IV training-allocation terminal.
